title: An accelerated rearrangement method for two-phase composite optimization
summary: We propose and analyze an Accelerated Rearrangement Method (ARM) for solving a class of nonconvex optimization problems involving two-phase composites. These problems include maximizing the (work) energy of a membrane governed by the Poisson equation and minimizing the principal eigenvalue of a weighted Dirichlet-Laplacian, both subject to material distribution constraints. Building on the classical rearrangement method, we introduce momentum-like acceleration by extrapolating the Fréchet derivative, leading to a provably convergent algorithm.
